# obs-114-4000: status filters observation
Action: prod-4000. Alias: Focus Shelf. Revision: we-1.0.0.
Retrieved 2026-02-27. Exposure began 2026-02-19; observation window 2026-02-20 through 2026-02-26. Cohort: new Android accounts in Canada. Eligible accounts in this report: 87.
Measure: successful completions; definition: unique completed operations per eligible active account. Initial estimate versus the matched prior surface: -3.8%. This is an operational estimate from this enrollment, with 7 reviewed recordings and 2 support conversations. It is not a randomized estimate for the entire product population.
Recording notes: selection was retained for one workspace but reset when the account changed. After the change, the first attempt completed but a resumed attempt did not. Customer language: 'I use status filters when checking the team work; I need to know whether the last step finished before I try it again.'
Known limits: the sample omits accounts that never opened the page. A feature rollout, a support import, and a user request can have different timestamps. Missing request dates remain unknown.
Original recommendation: keep the pilot narrow and inspect resumed sessions. Source receipts are attached to prod-4000; any later interpretation must preserve the actual disposition recorded there.
